_readme: One entry per curated, kept-live report page. `covers` tags the real field/function names each
entry exercises (not prose descriptions) — when a load-bearing shape changes (e.g. `_measurePick`,
finds exactly which corpus entries are at risk and need re-verifying before/after the change.
baselineCapturedAt/lastVerifiedAt are stamped ONLY by probe_corpus.mjs itself (--capture / a clean
diff pass respectively) — never hand-edit them, they're the tool's own record of what it has
actually machine-checked, not a claim about when a human last looked at the page.

entries.notes: Representative for the plain (non-difference) LineGraph code path, 2-route travelTime. Session-scoped page from 2026-08-07 was cleaned up per feedback_golden_corpus_pages_session_scoped — rebuild from the spec before first --capture.

Representative for the BarGraph code path AND the Layer-3 known-good-value PoC (see expectedValue) — chosen because `speed` is a near-raw average, the class of measure the team is most confident is already correctly computed (any discrepancy is most likely rounding, not a wrong formula). Rebuild before first --capture, same as linegraph.

expectedValue.description: NY-9D Northbound (route 2195805, TMCs 120+29712/120+29713/120+29714) average speed, Monday (toDayOfWeek(date,1)=1), 2025-01-01..2025-02-28. Computed independently: per-TMC avgIf(travel_time_all_vehicles, !=0) via direct ClickHouse SQL against npmrds.s583_v982_NPMRDS_V6, summed, combined with per-TMC miles from the UDA view-3464 reference-data endpoint (a static geometry lookup, not derived from this report's own rendering), via the report's own formula (sum(miles)*3600/sum(avg_travel_time_s)). Matched the live rendered value EXACTLY (19.57234077140305, to 15 significant digits) when computed 2026-08-10 — confirms the speed formula is correct for this measure, not just close.
expectedValue.groundTruthQuery: dbq.py ch "SELECT tmc, avgIf(toFloat64(travel_time_all_vehicles), travel_time_all_vehicles != 0) AS avg_tt FROM npmrds.s583_v982_NPMRDS_V6 WHERE tmc IN ('120+29713','120+29712','120+29714') AND date >= '2025-01-01' AND date <= '2025-02-28' AND toDayOfWeek(date,1)=1 GROUP BY tmc" + UDA viewsById/3464 miles lookup for the same 3 TMCs; speed = sum(miles)*3600/sum(avg_tt)

entries.notes: Representative for the per-TMC/day heat-grid code path — see graph-new-single-categorize-limit memory (GridGraph's yAxis-not-categorize quirk lives here). Rebuild before first --capture.

Representative for the Route Map / choropleth-baking code path — a real per-report choropleth baked server-side at build time, distinct from the other AVL Graph types. Rebuild before first --capture; the bake step's own dependencies (dama-tiles pg) must be reachable, not just ClickHouse.

entries.notes: PRIORITY entry — the Dynamic Report / catalog-template code path, distinct from --report-id conversions and the only corpus page exercising Bar Graph Summary. MUST keep the `?routes=` param (bypasses the Add-Routes entry-gate modal deterministically) — probing the bare slug tests only the empty-slot placeholder state, see report-probe-expect-and-golden-corpus.md's 2026-08-07 finding. `authRequired: false` confirmed live 2026-08-10 (renders publicly with real data despite the row's own `published` field reading back empty — that field isn't what gates public rendering here).
